titre: Black takes the knight. What does Lasker play? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Lasker – Bauer, Amsterdam 1889 (source: Wikipedia, chessgames). Black took the knight on h5, and Lasker gave both bishops: Bxh7+ and Bxg7, then Qg4+, the rook lift Rf3–h3 won the queen, and Qd7 forked two bishops. Lasker won in 38 moves. Checked with Stockfish. Would you have sacrificed both bishops? 👇
